title: Render: scatter local lights in the volumetric fog volume
abstract:
Part of #357. Local lights now scatter in the volumetric fog volume.

## Change

**Inject shader (`fog_scattering.comp.glsl`).** At each froxel midpoint, the shader runs the same `select_lights` cluster lookup that surfaces use and loops the selected lights. It skips:
- the sun index, which is already added;
- lights without `LIGHT_VOLUMETRIC`;
- lights whose `sample_light` radiance is zero.

Each remaining light adds `albedo × HG(dot(ray, light_dir), fog_anisotropy) × radiance × visibility`. Visibility is one zero-normal `shadow_visibility` sample when `light_casts_shadow`, and 1 otherwise. Directional lights other than the sun are included.

**`Light.volumetric`.**
- A positive bool. The `directional`, `point` and `spot` constructors set it to true, following the `ViewDesc.share_shadows` precedent.
- A bare `Light{}` does not scatter, as the docstring, `materials.md` and `sky.md` state.
- It maps to the new `LIGHT_VOLUMETRIC` bit (`abi/c3d.abi`, regenerated). `LightGpu` keeps its size.
- The light inspector gains a checkbox.

**Serialization.**
- `Light` moves to serial version 2, following the `FootIk`/`LodGroup` convention. The old layout is kept as a private `LightV1` with the old fingerprint, read by `read_light_v1` with `volumetric = true`, and `text_default_versions = {1}`.
- Checked end to end with throwaway programs. A v1 payload written by main reads back identical with `volumetric` true, in both binary and text. A v2 round trip keeps `volumetric = false`.

**Example.** `sky` gains:
- `--local-lights N`: lamps along the path ahead of the eye-level presets. The first 8 cast shadows; the atlas grows to 32 layers at 1024 when lamps exist.
- `--lamp-range` and `--lamps-in-fog on|off`, added for the reproducible cost and opt-out rows below.
- A "Lamps in fog" checkbox.

**Docs.** `sky.md` describes the rule, the cost lever (froxels × lights per cluster), the opt-out and the cluster-grid fallback share; `materials.md`, `serialization.md` and `benchmarking.md` cover the field, version 2 and the new flags. No measurements.

## Behaviour change

This is intended and default on: scenes with fog and local lights change. The following are byte-identical to main (1280×720, 8 frames, validation on):

| Scene | Main view | Mirror |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no lamps, noon | `92c01c8c…` | `c1d95e8d…` |
| no lamps, pan | `61c8e483…` | `7508efcc…` |
| no lamps, valley | `e0e1d21a…` | `0e648e91…` |
| no lamps, twilight | `4a72dde3…` | `8c5e27a4…` |
| 6 lamps opted out, twilight | `77e57119…` | same as main with 6 lamps |
| 6 lamps opted out, pan | `87e3f430…` | same as main with 6 lamps |

## Cost (lavapipe, environment only; the reviewer measures at 1440p on the 4090)

FOG_SCATTERING at noon, 1280×720, MEDIUM, O3. Each figure is the median of three per-run medians, in ms. In layout A, `--lamp-range 400` puts every lamp in every cell.

| Layout | Lights per cell | Main view | Mirror |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main, no lamps | 0 | 2.80 | 1.59 |
| PR, no lamps | 0 | 2.89 | 1.59 |
| A, 4 lamps | 4 | 6.13 | 2.56 |
| A, 16 lamps | 16 | 10.87 | 3.99 |
| A, 64 lamps (the cluster maximum) | 64 | 19.56 | 6.15 |
| A, 64 lamps opted out | 64 | 9.89 | 3.21 |
| range 14, 64 lamps | 3-5, plus flat fallback | 8.54 | 3.08 |
| range 14, 64 lamps, `far_distance` 200 (throwaway build) | 3-5 | 5.31 | 2.48 |

**Opt-out still walks the list.** Opting a light out saves its radiance and its shadow sample, but not the per-light read. `sky.md` says so.

**Flat-list fallback.** Froxels past the cluster grid fall back to the flat light list. The share was computed on the CPU from the slice and cluster depth mappings, assuming a 60° vertical FOV, near 0.1 and `far_distance` 100. It is the same for every quality:

| `max_distance` | Share of froxels past the grid |
| --- | --- |
| 50 | 0% |
| 100 | 0% |
| 200 (default) | 22.6% |
| 500 | 51.0% |
| 1000 | 65.4% |

Another 2.2% fall in front of the near plane at 200. The share matters: raising `far_distance` to 200 cut the 64-lamp default-range case from 8.1 to 5.3 ms. `sky.md` states the lever: raise `far_distance` along with `max_distance`.

## Verification

Linux (WSL), lavapipe, headless, validation on.

- **Unit filters:** `fog` 6/6, `light` 22/22, `view` 64/64, `sky` 11/11, and `describe` 38/38.
- **Serial targets, all pass:**

  | Target | Tests |
  | --- | --- |
  | `serial_core_policy_test` | 1 |
  | `serial_test` | 23 |
  | `serial_described_test` | 104 |
  | `serial_text_test` | 25 |
  | `serial_order_forward` | 2 |
  | `serial_order_reverse` | 2 |
  | `serial_all_test` | 2 |

- **Render acceptance:** all 26 cases with `fog`, `sky`, `atmosphere` or `light` in the name, one case per run, 0 VUIDs.
- **Shaders:** verify passes, 153 stages.
- **`sky`:** builds at O3.

Existing tests edited:
- `test_lights.c3`: two exact-`flags` asserts now mask `LIGHT_RT_SHADOW`, because the constructors set the new bit.
- The core policy test expects `Light` at version 2.

No tests were added.

Not exercised:
- The GUI checkboxes, which were only compile-checked because no display was available.
- Lamp scattering with traced shadows, which is covered only by the shader variants compiling.

The branch merges main (dense/empty atmospheres) with conflict resolution only.

## Remaining in #357

1. Per-view pre-exposure, its own change.
2. Temporal fog.
3. Above-the-atmosphere viewpoints.
4. A volumetric cloud layer.
5. Cloud shadows.
6. Cloud temporal.
